text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for your kindness in giving me 
a tour of the academy today... As 
expected, Tracen Academy truly is 
impressive."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
The meticulous work and the undeniable 
passion of the staff supporting the 
students... I am thoroughly impressed by 
it all.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
What the track maintenance crew shared 
really left an impression. To think they 
manage the condition of the woodchips, 
sand, and turf in such meticulous detail 
every single day.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
The reason why the Twinkle Series 
continues to move people's hearts to this 
day... I feel as though I've caught a 
glimpse of the unsung heroes behind it.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...This could work for our next project, 
too. Something like: "Behind the scenes of 
entertainment lies the drama of those who 
support it"—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Having Elfi do the interview and conveying 
the real atmosphere on the ground through 
video— ...Yes, if we polish it up, it 
could work.
